title: 🎓 2026/2027 Admission Lists Are Out — Check Your School!
message:
Big congratulations to everyone who has been offered admission! 🎉

Many universities have started releasing their admission lists for the 2026/2027 academic session.

🏛️ Schools with admission lists out:

• LASU — Lagos State University
• UNIBEN — University of Benin
• UNIZIK — Nnamdi Azikiwe University
• KWASU — Kwara State University
• EBSU — Ebonyi State University
• SAZU — Sa'adu Zungur University
• IAUE — Ignatius Ajuru University of Education
• UNIDEL — University of Delta
• OAUSTECH — Olusegun Agagu University of Science and Technology
• AUSU — Al-Istiqama University, Sumaila

And more schools are releasing lists every week!

🔍 How to check:
1. Visit your school's admission portal
2. Check JAMB CAPS — accept your admission if offered
3. Upload your O'Level result on JAMB portal

⚠️ Important:
• Admissions are released in batches
• If your name isn't on the first list, keep checking
• Don't miss the JAMB CAPS acceptance deadline

💡 Already admitted? Congratulations! Start prepping for your new journey with Exam Prep.

Still waiting? Stay positive — your admission is coming! 💪
